en.purpose: To determine the clinical T, N, and M categories and derive the TNM stage group for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma of the eyelid.
en.use:
Use to classify cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) of the eyelid by selecting the appropriate clinical TNM categories:
- Clinical T category (T0, Tis, T1a, T1b, T1c, T2a, T2b, T2c, T3a, T3b, T3c, T4, T4a, T4b), based on tumour diameter and extent of invasion of eyelid structures and adjacent ocular/orbital/facial tissues.
- Clinical N category (Nx, N0, N1, N2), based on regional lymph node involvement and nodal metastasis size/laterality.
- Clinical M category (M0, M1), based on presence of distant metastasis.

The guideline then derives the TNM stage group from the selected TNM categories using the UICC8 stage grouping table for eyelid skin cancer:
- Stage 0: Tis N0 M0
- Stage IA: T1 N0 M0
- Stage IB: T2a N0 M0
- Stage IIA: T2b/T2c/T3 N0 M0
- Stage IIB: T4 N0 M0
- Stage IIIA: Any T N1 M0
- Stage IIIB: Any T N2 M0
- Stage IV: Any T Any N M1
en.misuse:
Not to be used for TNM classification of non-eyelid cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (e.g., non-head and neck skin or head and neck skin excluding eyelid), which have different TNM/stage grouping rules.
Not to be used for pathological TNM (pTNM) staging if a separate pathological classification is required.

other_details.en: A structured guideline used to determine the clinical TNM (Tumour-Node-Metastasis) categories and stage group for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) of the eyelid, according to the UICC8 definitions.
